confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from three web searches of undated or mixed-date aggregator pages (Arabic-language cost-of-living page, trek.zone, combien-coute.net, Expatistan, Buenos Aires Herald Feb 2025), so they are rough and may not reflect July 2026 prices. Cappuccino and draft beer are the best-supported anchors. Meal anchors are inferred from ranges and a dinner-for-two pub figure. Cocktail and wine anchors are weakly sourced; the cocktail is anchored to downtown-club and bar ranges and the wine glass to a dated mid-range figure, with no firm local beer-to-wine basis. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context, not from inspected live listings or current booking pages. Prices are sensitive to Argentina's inflation and peso volatility.
comparable_city_reasoning: Buenos Aires is treated as a mid-cost Latin American capital for tourists: food and drink prices are set in part by local peso pricing and inflation, while hotel and hostel rates are benchmarked against other large South American capitals with comparable tourist demand.
